name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or behavior change
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Version

Output of `git rev-parse HEAD` (commit) or the release tag you're proposing
against.

## Use case

What are you trying to do, and why doesn't the current behavior support it?

## Proposed behavior

What you'd like Snagline to do instead. If the change touches the
PostgreSQL authority, JetStream delivery, edge projection, Buzz projection,
or an SSP wire family, say so explicitly and note which trust domain owns
the new behavior — see
[`docs/buzz-snagline-pristine-design.md`](../../docs/buzz-snagline-pristine-design.md).

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you didn't pick them.
